def can_complete_circuit(gas, cost):
    total = tank = start = 0
    for i in range(len(gas)):
        surplus = gas[i] - cost[i]
        total += surplus
        tank += surplus
        if tank < 0:                   # can't reach i+1 from start: restart there
            start, tank = i + 1, 0
    return start if total >= 0 else -1
X1-jump-game#dp:
def can_jump(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    good = [False] * n                 # good[i]: the end is reachable from i
    good[-1] = True
    for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):
        good[i] = any(good[j] for j in range(i + 1, min(n, i + nums[i] + 1)))
    return good[0]
X1-jump-game-ii:
def jump(nums):
    jumps = cur_end = far = 0
    for i in range(len(nums) - 1):
        far = max(far, i + nums[i])
        if i == cur_end:               # end of this BFS level: must jump
            jumps += 1
            cur_end = far
    return jumps
